messages:
Nia (docs): Quick FYI: Go SDK v0.9 will deprecate the legacy blocking client (Client.BlockingGenerate). We're publishing a migration guide and a tiny codemod. Link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/go/migrate-blocking

Owen (eng-go): Reason?

Nia (docs): Aligning surface area with other SDKs and reducing maintenance surface. New API is fully async-friendly: client.Generate(ctx, req) returns a Response struct.

Priya (product): Is this going to break customer code in prod? What's the compatibility window?

Owen (eng-go): Plan: release v0.9 with a compatibility shim that maps BlockingGenerate -> Generate under the hood for 45 days. Server will accept both call patterns for 30 days. After 30 days we'll start returning warnings; after 45 days the shim will be removed.

Marta (qa): Noted. Examples in examples/go-quickstart use BlockingGenerate. I'll open a PR to swap to the new pattern and add an e2e verifying both behaviors while the shim is live.

Nia (docs): Migration snippet for quick copy:

```go
// OLD
out, err := client.BlockingGenerate(ctx, "write a summary")

// NEW
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, &GenerateRequest{Prompt: "write a summary"})
fmt.Println(resp.Content)
```

Nia (docs): I've added a deprecation banner on the Go SDK docs page and a one-paragraph note in the Quickstart. Also queued a small devblog post for tomorrow.

Priya (product): Communication plan: console banner for all tenants, targeted email to Go-heavy customers (>100k tokens/mo), and a changelog entry. Jordan (release) please coordinate timing.

Owen (eng-go): Also adding a CI lint that flags BlockingGenerate usage in our sample repos and internal services. We'll merge the shim, but prefer customers upgrade soon.

notify-bot: changelog entry created -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/go-0.9-deprecate-blocking (created by Nia (docs)).

Marta (qa): CI note: nightly run showed two internal services still call BlockingGenerate; created tickets to update them. Will confirm green after PRs.

Owen (eng-go): If any customers break, escalate to @Owen (eng-go) and @Priya (product). We'll consider a short grace extension per-tenant if needed.

Nia (docs): Closing thread. Ping me for tenant-specific migration checklists or the codemod link.
